checks.name: required_columns_present
checks.details: Clean dataset must match the agreed contract.

checks.name: row_count_positive
checks.details: Clean dataset should contain at least one record.

checks.name: paper_id_not_null
checks.details: paper_id is required for retrieval hit-rate and evaluation matching.

checks.name: paper_id_unique
checks.details: Each paper_id should identify exactly one cleaned document.

checks.name: title_not_null
checks.details: Title is required for readable retrieval context and test-set generation.

checks.name: summary_completeness
checks.details: Summary/abstract gives semantic content for embedding and RAG answers.

checks.name: text_for_embedding_ready
checks.threshold: 0 empty text_for_embedding and short text rate <= 25%
checks.details: Embedding quality depends directly on text_for_embedding.

checks.name: freshness_age_days
checks.threshold: invalid age_days = 0 and stale rate <= 50%; threshold=180 days
checks.details: Freshness is computed from published date through age_days.
